title: Tailwind CSS Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the Tailwind CSS course.

entries.name: Meet utility classes
entries.summary: A utility class has one small style job.

entries.name: Add inner and outer space
entries.summary: Padding is space inside a box. Margin is space outside a box.

entries.name: Choose readable text
entries.summary: Text size and line spacing work together.

example.code:
Garden club

We plant seeds and watch them grow.

entries.name: Use colour and borders
entries.summary: A background fills a box, while a border marks its edge.

example.code:
<aside class="bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-950 border border-yellow-400 rounded-lg p-4">
  Bring water for the plants.
</aside>

entries.name: Line up a row with flex
entries.summary: Flex layout places child boxes in a row by default.

entries.name: Make grid columns
entries.summary: A grid can arrange boxes in rows and columns.

entries.name: Start small then grow
entries.summary: A responsive prefix applies a class from a chosen screen width upwards.

example.code:
First book
Second book

entries.name: Show keyboard focus
entries.summary: A state prefix changes a style when an element is in that state.

example.code:
<button class="rounded bg-blue-800 px-4 py-2 text-white hover:bg-blue-900 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-blue-800">
  Read a story
</button>

entries.name: Use the dark variant
entries.summary: The dark variant supplies styles for a dark colour setting.

example.code:
<article class="bg-white text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-white p-4">
  Evening reading
</article>

entries.name: Name a theme colour
entries.summary: A theme variable adds a design choice that Tailwind can turn into utilities.

entries.name: Keep class names complete
entries.summary: Tailwind finds class names by reading your source files as text.

entries.name: Put a card together
entries.summary: A small card combines several single-job classes.

example.code:

A story about a moon garden.
